props.name: locales
props.comment: The locales to show, one tab each. Must not be empty.

props.name: defaultLocale
props.comment:
The locale selected first. Ignored when it is not one of `locales`; without
it the app locale is used when listed, else the first locale.

props.name: groupKey
props.comment: Prefix that keeps the ids of two groups apart. Defaults to `""`.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to show. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: resource
props.comment: The resource the fields belong to. Defaults to the ambient resource.
